title: archkeel skill install — Install instructions for the agent

story.title: archkeel skill install — Install instructions for the agent

steps.title: Start the command
steps.note: Run archkeel skill install codex in the repository. The claude option follows the same installer.

steps.title: Read the arguments
steps.note: The dispatcher selects the skill installer and the output mode.

steps.title: Choose the repository
steps.note: The command passes the repository root and selected agent to the installer.

steps.title: Read the bundled instructions
steps.note: Read the packaged skill so the instructions match the installed CLI.

steps.title: Write SKILL.md
steps.note: The installer writes the skill and returns its path.

steps.title: Show the installed path
steps.note: The CLI prints the path and exits successfully. JSON mode returns the same path in the result.
